compiled_state.title: S4.T4: Add merge-pipeline-checks umbrella job in ci.yml + red-test-blocker step + register required-check
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: A CI required-check named under an umbrella job scans `.test-index` on the merged tree and blocks session\xe2\x86\x92main merge.
- DD2: Check is registered under an umbrella job with a stable check-context name. Branch protection can require this single name.
- DD4: This story bootstraps the check; S_migration handles branch-protection enforcement separately.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:

1. Add a new job `merge-pipeline-checks` that always runs on `pull_request` events (`if: always()` or no `if`); it has a stable check-context name that branch protection can require.
2. Add a step `red-test-blocker` inside `merge-pipeline-checks`:
   - Only execute the scan logic when the PR base is main AND head matches a session pattern (`session/**`, `session-**`, `session_**`, or `bug-batch/**`). Use `if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && (startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'session/') || ...)` or equivalent.
   - When the conditional fires: invoke `bash plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"`. Pass commit SHAs (not refs) to avoid race conditions with concurrent pushes.
   - When the conditional does not fire: step is a no-op success (umbrella still reports success on the stable check-context name).
3. Job-level `actions/checkout@v4` with `fetch-depth: 0` so `git merge-tree` has both refs available.
4. The umbrella job name (e.g., `merge-pipeline-checks`) is the stable check-context name; the inner step's name (`red-test-blocker`) is the scan identity.

Register the new check-context in `.github/required-checks.txt` (or equivalent — verify the file's existing schema):
- Append `merge-pipeline-checks` (or the umbrella job's exact `name:`) to the required-checks manifest.
- Do NOT touch branch-protection itself \xe2\x80\x94 S_migration owns the branch-protection rollout.

After implementation: T3's behavioral test must pass GREEN. Remove `.test-index` markers from T1/T3.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | modify | `tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh` (RED in T3) | needs-modification |
| `.github/required-checks.txt` | modify | (no direct test \xe2\x80\x94 schema check at commit time) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | remove markers |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] ci.yml is schema-valid (actionlint)
  Verify: (command -v actionlint >/dev/null && actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml) || python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"
- [ ] ci.yml contains a merge-pipeline-checks (or equivalent) umbrella job
  Verify: grep -qE 'merge-pipeline-checks|red-test-blocker' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] ci.yml step invokes scan-red-markers.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'scan-red-markers.sh' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] required-checks.txt includes the new umbrella job's check-context name
  Verify: grep -qE 'merge-pipeline-checks|red-test-blocker' .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] T3's behavioral test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh
- [ ] .test-index no longer carries either RED marker from T1 or T3
  Verify: ! grep -E '\[test_scan_red_markers_unit\]|\[test_red_test_blocker_two_subpr\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user

comments.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F4 critical + gap-analysis #4 #5):

**Plan-review F4 — REWRITE: GitHub Actions check-contexts are JOB-level, not STEP-level**. The 'umbrella step' concept is wrong. Implement as a single new JOB in ci.yml whose 'name:' field IS the stable check-context. Branch protection requires that job name. Steps within the job may be conditional (only run scan when base==main && head matches session/**), but the JOB always runs and reports a stable name. The check-context registered in required-checks.txt is the JOB's name field verbatim.

**Plan-review F5 — bootstrap resolved**: GitHub runs pull_request workflows from PR HEAD's workflow file (refs/pull/N/merge). The first PR that adds the workflow file ALSO runs it. No special bootstrap phase needed.

**Gap-analysis #3 SHA capture at job-start**: The job's FIRST step captures \${github.event.pull_request.head.sha} and \${github.event.pull_request.base.sha} into env vars; all subsequent steps receive these via env, not via re-reading event fields (avoids race).

**Gap-analysis #4 override/exemption**: Implement an override mechanism for intentional RED markers. Prefer: a header-line allowlist in .test-index of the form '# DEFERRED: <path>:<test_name> reason=<text> ticket=<id>'. When a marker matches an exemption, scanner logs 'WARN: RED marker <path>:<test_name> intentionally deferred (ticket=<id>) — not blocking' and does NOT exit non-zero. Both blocking and exempt markers are listed in the job output.

**Gap-analysis #5 S5 coordination**: Before committing ci.yml changes, 'git fetch origin' and verify whether S5 has staged changes to ci.yml. Add the new job as a SELF-CONTAINED block (own 'jobs:' entry); minimize textual overlap with existing job sections. If S5's branch lands first, rebase on it.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] ci.yml contains a NEW job (not a new step within an existing job) with stable name field
  Verify: yq '.jobs | keys | .[]' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -qE 'red-test-blocker|merge-pipeline'
- [ ] required-checks.txt contains the job's exact 'name:' field value
  Verify: NAME=$(yq '.jobs["merge-pipeline-checks"].name // ""' .github/workflows/ci.yml) && grep -qF "$NAME" .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] SHAs captured at job-start (first step) into env vars
  Verify: grep -qE 'BASE_SHA.*github.event.pull_request.base.sha' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] Override mechanism documented in .test-index header or workflow logic
  Verify: grep -qE 'DEFERRED.*ticket=|override.*marker' .github/workflows/ci.yml plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh
- [ ] No textual conflict with existing ci.yml jobs (self-contained block)
  Verify: actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml
